legend: Leha is planning his journey from Moscow to Saratov. He hates trains, so he has decided to get from one city to another by car.

The path from Moscow to Saratov can be represented as a straight line (well, it's not that straight in reality, but in this problem we will consider it to be straight), and the distance between Moscow and Saratov is n$$$n$$$ km. Let's say that Moscow is situated at the point with coordinate 0$$$0$$$ km, and Saratov — at coordinate n$$$n$$$ km.

Driving for a long time may be really difficult. Formally, if Leha has already covered i$$$i$$$ kilometers since he stopped to have a rest, he considers the difficulty of covering (i+1)$$$(i + 1)$$$-th kilometer as ai+1$$$a_{i + 1}$$$. It is guaranteed that for every i∈[1,n−1]$$$i \in [1, n - 1]$$$ ai≤ai+1$$$a_i \le a_{i + 1}$$$. The difficulty of the journey is denoted as the sum of difficulties of each kilometer in the journey.

Fortunately, there may be some rest sites between Moscow and Saratov. Every integer point from 1$$$1$$$ to n−1$$$n - 1$$$ may contain a rest site. When Leha enters a rest site, he may have a rest, and the next kilometer will have difficulty a1$$$a_1$$$, the kilometer after it — difficulty a2$$$a_2$$$, and so on.

For example, if n=5$$$n = 5$$$ and there is a rest site in coordinate 2$$$2$$$, the difficulty of journey will be 2a1+2a2+a3$$$2a_1 + 2a_2 + a_3$$$: the first kilometer will have difficulty a1$$$a_1$$$, the second one — a2$$$a_2$$$, then Leha will have a rest, and the third kilometer will have difficulty a1$$$a_1$$$, the fourth — a2$$$a_2$$$, and the last one — a3$$$a_3$$$. Another example: if n=7$$$n = 7$$$ and there are rest sites in coordinates 1$$$1$$$ and 5$$$5$$$, the difficulty of Leha's journey is 3a1+2a2+a3+a4$$$3a_1 + 2a_2 + a_3 + a_4$$$.

Leha doesn't know which integer points contain rest sites. So he has to consider every possible situation. Obviously, there are 2n−1$$$2^{n - 1}$$$ different distributions of rest sites (two distributions are different if there exists some point x$$$x$$$ such that it contains a rest site in exactly one of these distributions). Leha considers all these distributions to be equiprobable. He wants to calculate p$$$p$$$ — the expected value of difficulty of his journey.
Obviously, p⋅2n−1$$$p \cdot 2^{n - 1}$$$ is an integer number. You have to calculate it modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.
input: The first line contains one number n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤106$$$1 \le n \le 10^6$$$) — the distance from Moscow to Saratov.

The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integer numbers a1$$$a_1$$$, a2$$$a_2$$$, ..., an$$$a_n$$$ (1≤a1≤a2≤⋯≤an≤106$$$1 \le a_1 \le a_2 \le \dots \le a_n \le 10^6$$$), where ai$$$a_i$$$ is the difficulty of i$$$i$$$-th kilometer after Leha has rested.
output: Print one number — p⋅2n−1$$$p \cdot 2^{n - 1}$$$, taken modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: Leha 正在计划从莫斯科到萨拉托夫的旅程。他讨厌火车，因此决定开车从一个城市前往另一个城市。
从莫斯科到萨拉托夫的路径可以表示为一条直线(实际上它并没有这么直，但在本题中我们将其视为直线)，莫斯科和萨拉托夫之间的距离为 n$$$n$$$ 千米。设莫斯科位于坐标为 0$$$0$$$ 千米的点，萨拉托夫位于坐标为 n$$$n$$$ 千米的点。

长时间驾驶可能会非常困难。形式化地说，如果 Leha 自上次休息以来已经行驶了 i$$$i$$$ 千米，那么他认为行驶第 (i+1)$$$(i + 1)$$$ 千米的困难度为 ai+1$$$a_{i + 1}$$$。保证对于每个 i∈[1,n−1]$$$i \in [1, n - 1]$$$，都有 ai≤ai+1$$$a_i \le a_{i + 1}$$$。此次旅程的困难度定义为旅程中每千米困难度之和。
幸运的是，莫斯科和萨拉托夫之间可能存在一些休息点。从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 的每个整数点都可能包含一个休息点。当 Leha 进入休息点时，他可以休息，此后的第一千米困难度将为 a1$$$a_1$$$，再下一千米的困难度为 a2$$$a_2$$$，以此类推。

例如，如果 n=5$$$n = 5$$$，且坐标 2$$$2$$$ 处有一个休息点，那么旅程的困难度将为 2a1+2a2+a3$$$2a_1 + 2a_2 + a_3$$$：第一千米的困难度为 a1$$$a_1$$$，第二千米的困难度为 a2$$$a_2$$$，随后 Leha 休息，第三千米的困难度为 a1$$$a_1$$$，第四千米的困难度为 a2$$$a_2$$$，最后一千米的困难度为 a3$$$a_3$$$。再例如，如果 n=7$$$n = 7$$$，且坐标 1$$$1$$$ 和 5$$$5$$$ 处有休息点，那么 Leha 此次旅程的困难度为 3a1+2a2+a3+a4$$$3a_1 + 2a_2 + a_3 + a_4$$$。
Leha 不知道哪些整数点包含休息点。因此，他必须考虑每一种可能的情况。显然，休息点共有 2n−1$$$2^{n - 1}$$$ 种不同的分布方式(如果存在某个点 x$$$x$$$，使得它恰好在其中一种分布中包含休息点，则称两种分布不同)。Leha 认为所有这些分布等概率。他希望计算 p$$$p$$$，即其旅程困难度的期望值。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤106$$$1 \le n \le 10^6$$$)，表示从莫斯科到萨拉托夫的距离。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1$$$a_1$$$、a2$$$a_2$$$、...、an$$$a_n$$$(1≤a1≤a2≤⋯≤an≤106$$$1 \le a_1 \le a_2 \le \dots \le a_n \le 10^6$$$)，其中 ai$$$a_i$$$ 表示在 Leha 休息后经过第 i$$$i$$$ 千米的难度。
